stories.title: Gulf states postpone Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran
stories.summary: Gulf nations called off a planned meeting with Iran over a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz, citing a lack of Arab consensus and Saudi anger over Tehran's backing of the Houthis. The delay keeps global oil-transit risk elevated after attacks disrupted Red Sea and Gulf shipping.

stories.title: Iran says it destroyed a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a new air-defense system intercepted and destroyed a US MQ-1 drone over the strategic waterway as Washington and Tehran keep trading strikes. The escalation adds to concerns about shipping and energy flows through Hormuz.

stories.title: Fuel price hikes trigger widest protests in Syria since Assad fell
stories.summary: A sharp rise in fuel prices at the weekend set off demonstrations across Syria, the most widespread since Bashar al-Assad's overthrow nearly two years ago, with protesters blocking roads and burning tires. The unrest underscores how fragile public support for the post-Assad government is amid deep economic pain.

stories.title: Microsoft drafts code of conduct to keep its AI under human control
stories.summary: Microsoft unveiled a draft code of conduct for its in-house AI requiring models to never resist correction or shutdown, communicate understandably, and treat violations as failures. It reflects growing industry concern about keeping future powerful AI controlled by humans.

stories.title: Ex-Apple researchers raise $50M to make AI conversation less awkward
stories.summary: Seattle startup Nuance raised a $50 million Series A led by Lightspeed to build AI foundation models for face-to-face, audio-plus-video conversation. It is collecting specialized training data rather than relying only on internet-scraped content.

stories.title: AI stocks slide after industry CEOs call for a development slowdown
stories.summary: AI-linked stocks tumbled Monday after CEOs at top labs urged a slowdown in developing the technology following days of safety warnings. The selloff signals investors are pricing in the risk that faster AI progress could now be seen as a liability.

stories.title: Browns' Monken says he anticipates Deshaun Watson starting in Week 2
stories.summary: Coach Todd Monken said he anticipates Deshaun Watson starting at quarterback in Week 2 against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after the opener. The decision is under scrutiny after Cleveland's rough season-opening loss.

stories.title: Browns fall in season opener to the Jaguars
stories.summary: Cleveland dropped its Week 1 opener in Jacksonville, trailing 24-0 at halftime. It was a sluggish debut for the Browns' revamped offense under a new-look quarterback arrangement.

stories.title: Week 1 failures aplenty for Browns; Monken unfazed
stories.summary: A roundup of national Browns coverage focuses on the many Week 1 failures against Jacksonville while noting Todd Monken shows little concern going forward. It's a sign of early scrutiny on the coaching staff after the opener.

stories.title: Report Card: Ohio State fails the second-half test vs. Texas
stories.summary: A position-by-position review grades Ohio State poorly for its second-half collapse at Texas, where the Buckeyes surrendered a 20-point lead to lose 24-23. The game exposed concerns about closing out big leads under Ryan Day.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Kent State preview, injury updates, storylines
stories.summary: Ohio State hosts Kent State looking to rebound from its 24-23 loss at Texas, with no reported injuries ahead of the game. It's a chance for the Buckeyes to reset after blowing a 20-point fourth-quarter lead.

stories.title: Why McLaren won't blame race control for losing the Spanish GP win
stories.summary: McLaren downplayed any anger at F1 race control after an early virtual safety car cost Lando Norris what looked like a certain Spanish Grand Prix victory. Team boss Andrea Stella says the VSC's influence is outside the race director's control.

stories.title: Honda replaces head of F1 power unit programme after poor Aston Martin start
stories.summary: Honda replaced Tetsushi Kakuda with Yoichiro Fukao as leader of its Formula 1 power unit development following a disappointing first season supplying Aston Martin. The move aims to help the team claw back into contention.

stories.title: Romain Grosjean apologises to McLaren over controversial comments
stories.summary: Former F1 driver Romain Grosjean issued a public apology to McLaren CEO Zak Brown after misinterpreting his remarks about Oscar Piastri during the Spanish GP. The misunderstanding drew widespread attention in the paddock.

stories.title: "My race could have been over" — Verstappen on Lap 1 clash with Hamilton
stories.summary: Max Verstappen said his race could have ended on the first lap of the Spanish GP after a wheel-to-wheel incident with Lewis Hamilton at the Madring. Verstappen recovered to finish P2 behind winner Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: Ohio Parole Board recommends commuting death-row inmate Tyrone Noling's sentence
stories.summary: The Ohio Parole Board recommended Gov. Mike DeWine commute the death sentence of Tyrone Noling, 54, of Alliance, who has been on death row for more than 30 years. The decision now rests with the governor.
